Build SQL for a concept's unit conversion

Source: R/atomic_concepts.R
concept_unit_conversion_func.Rd

Returns a SQL expression (string) that casts the source value to NUMERIC and optionally applies a unit conversion when the source unit does not match the target unit.

Usage

concept_unit_conversion_func(
  conversion,
  val_var,
  unit_var,
  target_unit,
  concept_name = NA_character_
)

Arguments

conversion

Conversion type string from the concept config. Supported formats:

  • "none" - no conversion, cast to NUMERIC as-is.

  • "*N" or "/N" - multiply or divide every value by N. Only for items without a unit column; with a unit column this is an error, because unrecognised units would be converted too. Use "map" instead.

  • "f_to_c" - Fahrenheit to Celsius conversion. With a unit column, only recognised Fahrenheit labels (F, Deg. F, ...) are converted; values already in target_unit or with no unit are kept, and any other unit becomes NULL.

  • "cond_f_to_c" - for items without a unit: values above 70 are taken as Fahrenheit and converted.

  • "fio2_fraction" - for FiO2 items that mix fractions and percents: values in (0, 1] are multiplied by 100, values in (1, 20) become NULL, and all others are kept as percents.

  • "ca_ionized_by_value" - for ionized calcium reported as mmol/L or mg/dL under one unit label (eICU): values up to 2 are taken as mmol/L, values of 3.5 or more as mg/dL and multiplied by 0.2495, and values in between become NULL. The unit column is ignored.

  • "dipstick_grade" - for qualitative urine dipstick results: NEG is 0, SM/1+ is 1, MOD/2+ is 2 and LG/3+ is 3 (full words are accepted too). The unit column is ignored and any other text becomes NULL.

  • "exposure" - exposure-only concepts (antibiotics): every row's value is 1, whatever amount or unit the source recorded; the original text stays in value_raw and unit_raw.

  • "map" - multi-unit lookup. Factors are read from rendehr_concepts_unit_conversion_map.csv, keyed by concept_name and source_unit. The target unit is always taken from the unit column of the concept config (not the map file). Any source unit not listed in the map that also does not match the target unit is set to NULL, and so is a row without a unit. A map row with an empty factor records a unit that is excluded on purpose (for example an absolute count reported under a percentage concept); its values are NULL too. Use this when a source column contains more than one unit across rows (e.g. CRP in mimic_iv stored as both mg/dL and ug/mL).

val_var

Source column name holding the raw value.

unit_var

Source column name holding the unit label (may be NA).

target_unit

Target unit string (from the unit column in the concept config); used as the reference for conditional conversion.

concept_name

Concept name. Required when conversion = "map" so the unit conversion map can be filtered to the correct concept.

Value

SQL expression string.

Details

The value is parsed as a number when it is plain or comma-grouped digits with an optional sign, decimal point, exponent (1e3) or trailing %. Anything else, including censored values such as <0.5, becomes NULL; the original text stays in value_raw.

Examples

cat(concept_unit_conversion_func("f_to_c", "valuenum", "valueuom", "C", "temperature"))
#> CASE
#>          WHEN src.valueuom IS NULL THEN CASE
#>      WHEN TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT) ~ '^[+-]?((([0-9]+)|([0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})+))(\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?%?$'
#>      THEN CASE
#>        WHEN ABS(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT), '%', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) < 1e28
#>        THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT), '%', ''), ',', '') AS NUMERIC(38,9))
#>        ELSE NULL
#>      END
#>      ELSE NULL
#>    END
#>          WHEN LOWER(TRIM(CAST(src.valueuom AS TEXT))) = LOWER(TRIM('C')) THEN CASE
#>      WHEN TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT) ~ '^[+-]?((([0-9]+)|([0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})+))(\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?%?$'
#>      THEN CASE
#>        WHEN ABS(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT), '%', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) < 1e28
#>        THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT), '%', ''), ',', '') AS NUMERIC(38,9))
#>        ELSE NULL
#>      END
#>      ELSE NULL
#>    END
#>          WHEN LOWER(TRIM(CAST(src.valueuom AS TEXT))) IN ('f', '°f', '?f', 'deg. f', 'deg.f', 'deg f', 'degf', 'degrees f', 'fahrenheit') THEN (CASE
#>      WHEN TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT) ~ '^[+-]?((([0-9]+)|([0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})+))(\.[0-9]*)?|\.[0-9]+)([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?%?$'
#>      THEN CASE
#>        WHEN ABS(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT), '%', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) < 1e28
#>        THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(src.valuenum::TEXT), '%', ''), ',', '') AS NUMERIC(38,9))
#>        ELSE NULL
#>      END
#>      ELSE NULL
#>    END - 32) * 5.0/9.0
#>          ELSE NULL
#>        END
